title: day 6: Created the first town for my Survival Cozy game.
author: Fluffy-Discussion166

comments.author: Friendly-Beginning72
comments.body: the town already has a nice cozy feel, im doing a frozen survival thing too (Last Warmth) and getting the first settlement to feel warm was way harder than i expected

replies.author: Fluffy-Discussion166
replies.body:
yea. I also worried about making it too hard for new player. probably will add a difficulty setting. 

Im thinking of making clean water the most important thing of this game. every survivors and players will fight for clean water. players need prioritize time to loot for materials to build rain collection system or loot for weapons + upgrade.

replies.author: Fluffy-Discussion166
replies.body: Opus 5.5: create 3d shape of the assets with Blender > upload the assets files into Gemini, prompt it to overpaint the the shape into final asset.
